meta.description: Receives an ElevenLabs post-call webhook, maps a finished or unanswered call into the DentalFlow call payload, and posts it to CORE — Call Intake. See /docs/N8N_WORKFLOWS.md.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ organization_id: $json.organization_id, direction: $json.direction, caller_name: $json.caller_name, phone: $json.phone, status: $json.status, intent: $json.intent, outcome: $json.outcome, duration_seconds: $json.duration_seconds, started_at: $json.started_at, notes: $json.notes, ai_handled: $json.ai_handled === true, transcript: $json.transcript || null }) }}
